blocks.zh: 生物評估框架、文獻審查程序與參考書目
blocks.en: Biological Evaluation Framework, Literature Review Procedure and Bibliography

blocks.zh: Learning Objectives 學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: Understand Annex B as the operational "how-to" guide that translates the ISO 10993-1 framework into a step-by-step risk management workflow 理解 Annex B 如何將 ISO 10993-1 框架轉化為逐步風險管理作業流程
blocks.en: Understand Annex B as the operational "how-to" guide that translates the ISO 10993-1 framework into a step-by-step risk management workflow

blocks.zh: Apply the 7-step biological evaluation process: hazard ID → risk estimation → risk evaluation → risk control → residual risk → benefit-risk → monitoring 應用七步驟生物評估流程
blocks.en: Apply the 7-step biological evaluation process: hazard ID → risk estimation → risk evaluation → risk control → residual risk → benefit-risk → monitoring

blocks.zh: Understand the role of material characterization, extractables/leachables, and clinical history data in risk estimation 理解材料表徵、E&L 數據與臨床歷史在風險估算中的角色
blocks.en: Understand the role of material characterization, extractables/leachables, and clinical history data in risk estimation

blocks.zh: Know how to design and document a systematic literature review per Annex C 依 Annex C 設計並記錄系統性文獻審查
blocks.en: Know how to design and document a systematic literature review per Annex C

blocks.zh: Recognize the ICH Q3 series as cross-referencing pillars alongside ISO 10993 認識 ICH Q3 系列與 ISO 10993 的交叉引用關係
blocks.en: Recognize the ICH Q3 series as cross-referencing pillars alongside ISO 10993

blocks.zh: 中文解析 — Annex B 總覽與定位
blocks.en: Commentary — Annex B Overview and Positioning

blocks.zh: Annex B 是什麼？
blocks.en: What is Annex B?

blocks.zh: 如果說 ISO 10993-1 本文是「What（要做什麼）」，那 Annex B 就是「How（怎麼做）」。它把整份標準的框架翻譯成一套可操作的風險管理作業流程，是整個 ISO 10993-1 最有實務價值的章節。
blocks.en: If the main body of ISO 10993-1 is the "What" (what needs to be done), then Annex B is the "How" (how to do it). It translates the framework of the whole standard into an operational risk management workflow, and it is the most practically valuable part of ISO 10993-1.

blocks.zh: 關鍵定位：Annex B 是 informative（資訊性），不是 normative（規範性）。也就是說，它不能被用來作為法規稽核或認證評估的直接依據，但卻是理解整套系統最重要的參考文件。
blocks.en: Key positioning: Annex B is informative, not normative. This means it cannot be used as a direct basis for regulatory audits or certification assessments, but it is the most important reference document for understanding the whole system.

blocks.zh: 類比：設計驗證活動 vs. 品質管制
blocks.en: Analogy: design verification activity vs. quality control

blocks.zh: 生物評估是「設計驗證活動」（design verification activity）。這個定位非常重要 —— 它意味著生物安全性的評估應該在產品設計階段就開始，而不是等到生產後才做。
blocks.en: Biological evaluation is a "design verification activity". This positioning matters: it means the biological safety evaluation should begin at the product design stage, not after production.

blocks.zh: 類比：就像結構工程師在設計建築時就要算承重，而不是蓋好之後再去測試它會不會塌。CDMO 的角色就是在 tech transfer 的起點，就要問客戶：「你的生物風險評估做到哪一步了？」
blocks.en: Analogy: a structural engineer calculates the load-bearing capacity while designing the building, not after it is built and someone tests whether it will collapse. The CDMO's role is to ask the client at the very start of tech transfer: "How far along is your biological risk assessment?"

blocks.zh: 科學進化趨勢：減少動物實驗
blocks.en: Scientific trend: reducing animal testing

blocks.zh: Annex B 明確指出一個重要趨勢：生物評估正在朝向「以化學表徵與文獻審查為主、動物實驗為輔」的方向演進。當 in vitro 方法能提供同等相關資訊時，應優先採用。
blocks.en: Annex B states clearly that biological evaluation is evolving toward an approach led by chemical characterization and literature review, with animal testing in a supporting role. When in vitro methods can provide equivalent relevant information, they should be preferred.

blocks.zh: 這對 CDMO 的實務意義：建立完整的材料表徵資料庫，有機會減少高成本、長週期的動物測試，加速開發時程。
blocks.en: What this means in practice for a CDMO: building a complete material characterization database can reduce high-cost, long-duration animal testing and speed up the development timeline.

blocks.zh: 與 ISO 14971 的關係
blocks.en: Relationship with ISO 14971

blocks.zh: Annex B 的整個架構都建立在 ISO 14971（醫療器材風險管理）之上。生物評估不是獨立存在的 —— 它是整體風險管理計劃（Risk Management Plan, RMP）的一個子集。
blocks.en: The entire structure of Annex B is built on ISO 14971 (risk management for medical devices). Biological evaluation does not stand alone; it is a subset of the overall Risk Management Plan (RMP).

blocks.zh: 換言之：Biological Evaluation Plan = RMP 的一部分，而不是一份獨立文件。
blocks.en: In other words: the Biological Evaluation Plan is part of the RMP, not a standalone document.

blocks.zh: 中文解析 — 生物評估作為風險管理實踐
blocks.en: Commentary — Biological Evaluation as Risk Management Practice

blocks.zh: 核心概念：風險效益平衡
blocks.en: Core concept: balancing risk and benefit

blocks.zh: B.2 開宗明義指出生物評估的本質是「持續性風險管理流程」，而不是一次性的測試活動。最重要的原則是：患者使用醫療器材本身就接受了某種程度的風險，關鍵是這個風險是否被預期效益所抵消。
blocks.en: B.2 opens by stating that the essence of biological evaluation is an "ongoing risk management process", not a one-time testing activity. The most important principle is that a patient using a medical device already accepts some level of risk; the key question is whether that risk is outweighed by the expected benefit.

blocks.zh: 這就是為什麼不存在「零風險」的醫療器材 —— 評估的是「可接受風險」，而非「無風險」。
blocks.en: This is why no "zero-risk" medical device exists: what is evaluated is "acceptable risk", not "no risk".

blocks.zh: CDMO 實戰情境：Tech Transfer 起點
blocks.en: CDMO scenario: the starting point of tech transfer

blocks.zh: 當一個新藥廠客戶把注射劑產品委託給你的 CDMO 進行 tech transfer 時，你應該在技術交接文件清單上加入一項：「請提供 Biological Risk Assessment（BRA）」。
blocks.en: When a new pharma client entrusts an injectable product to your CDMO for tech transfer, you should add one item to the technical handover checklist: "Please provide the Biological Risk Assessment (BRA)".

blocks.zh: Annex B 定義的就是這份 BRA 應該包含什麼。如果客戶說「我們還沒做」，你需要協助他們評估哪些材料需要生物相容性數據。
blocks.en: Annex B defines what this BRA should contain. If the client says "we haven't done one yet", you need to help them assess which materials require biocompatibility data.

blocks.zh: 具體場景：你們使用的矽膠管（silicone tubing）換了供應商。這不只是一個材料採購問題 —— 按照 B.2 的邏輯，換供應商就意味著需要重新評估材料的生物安全性，起碼要比對新舊供應商的 CoA 與 extractables 數據。
blocks.en: Specific scenario: the silicone tubing you use has changed supplier. This is not just a purchasing issue. By the logic of B.2, a change of supplier means the biological safety of the material must be re-evaluated, at the very least by comparing the CoAs and extractables data of the old and new suppliers.

blocks.zh: 材料表徵（Material Characterization）是起點
blocks.en: Material characterization is the starting point

blocks.zh: 整個風險管理流程的起點是材料表徵。這包括：
blocks.en: The starting point of the whole risk management process is material characterization. This includes:

blocks.zh: 供應商 CoA（Certificate of Analysis）
blocks.en: Supplier CoA (Certificate of Analysis)

blocks.zh: 毒理學數據包（Toxicological Data Package）
blocks.en: Toxicological Data Package

blocks.zh: Extractables & Leachables（E&L）數據
blocks.en: Extractables & Leachables (E&L) data

blocks.zh: 歷史臨床使用資料（History of Safe Use）
blocks.en: History of Safe Use (clinical use history)

blocks.zh: 關鍵原則：「同材料、同應用」——如果一種橡膠塞子在注射製劑上有 20 年安全使用歷史，這是非常有力的證據，可以大幅減少需要進行的新測試。
blocks.en: Key principle: "same material, same application". If a rubber stopper has 20 years of safe use history in injectable products, this is very strong evidence and can greatly reduce the new testing required.

blocks.zh: 不能只列出要做哪些測試！
blocks.en: Do not just list the tests to be done!

blocks.zh: B.2.2 有一個非常重要的警示：Biological Evaluation Plan 不能只是列出「我要做 cytotoxicity、sensitization、genotoxicity...」這樣的測試清單。
blocks.en: B.2.2 gives an important warning: the Biological Evaluation Plan must not be merely a list of tests such as "I will do cytotoxicity, sensitization, genotoxicity...".

blocks.zh: ISO 14971 的要求是：每一項測試都必須有其風險分析依據。換言之，你的計劃要解釋「為什麼要做這些測試」以及「為什麼不需要做其他測試」。
blocks.en: ISO 14971 requires that every test have a risk analysis rationale. In other words, your plan must explain "why these tests are being done" and "why no other tests are needed".

blocks.zh: 監管稽查員最常發現的問題之一：廠商的 BEP 只是 Annex A 的複製貼上，沒有任何風險分析邏輯支撐。
blocks.en: One of the problems regulatory inspectors find most often: the manufacturer's BEP is simply a copy and paste of Annex A, with no risk analysis logic behind it.

blocks.zh: 實作框架：Biological Evaluation Plan 最低要求
blocks.en: Implementation framework: minimum requirements for a Biological Evaluation Plan

blocks.zh: 文獻收集策略（資料庫、搜尋關鍵字、納入/排除標準）
blocks.en: Literature collection strategy (databases, search keywords, inclusion/exclusion criteria)

blocks.zh: 評估執行安排（誰負責？需要什麼專業能力？）
blocks.en: Arrangements for carrying out the evaluation (who is responsible? what expertise is required?)

blocks.zh: 審查與批准流程（與 design control 整合）
blocks.en: Review and approval process (integrated with design control)

blocks.zh: 額外測試的決策邏輯與批准機制
blocks.en: Decision logic and approval mechanism for additional testing

blocks.zh: 殘餘風險揭露方式（標籤、警語、使用說明）
blocks.en: How residual risk is communicated (labeling, warnings, instructions for use)

blocks.zh: 中文解析 — 風險管理七步驟詳解
blocks.en: Commentary — The Seven Steps of Risk Management in Detail

blocks.zh: 風險分析起點：最終製造態（Final Form）
blocks.en: Starting point of risk analysis: the final form

blocks.zh: B.3.1.2 強調一個關鍵細節：風險分析必須基於「醫療器材在製造完成狀態下的最終形式」，不是材料原料的狀態。
blocks.en: B.3.1.2 stresses a key detail: the risk analysis must be based on the "final form of the medical device in its finished manufactured state", not on the state of the raw material.

blocks.zh: CDMO 類比：你不是在評估空瓶子的安全性，而是評估裝有藥液、經過滅菌、在包裝材料保護下、歷經運輸老化之後的完整產品。這意味著滅菌殘留物（sterilant residues）、包裝材料的 extractables，都必須納入考量。
blocks.en: CDMO analogy: you are not evaluating the safety of an empty vial, but the complete product that contains the drug solution, has been sterilized, is protected by its packaging materials, and has aged through transport. This means sterilant residues and extractables from packaging materials must all be taken into account.

blocks.zh: B.3.1.3 風險估算：E&L 的核心地位
blocks.en: B.3.1.3 Risk estimation: the central role of E&L

blocks.zh: 風險估算中最關鍵的化學毒性評估路徑是：
blocks.en: The most critical chemical toxicity evaluation pathway in risk estimation is:

blocks.zh: Extractables：在最嚴苛萃取條件下，材料能釋放什麼？（潛在上限）
blocks.en: Extractables: what can the material release under the harshest extraction conditions? (potential upper limit)

blocks.zh: Leachables：在實際使用條件下，材料真正釋放多少？（臨床實際暴露量）
blocks.en: Leachables: how much does the material actually release under real conditions of use? (actual clinical exposure)

blocks.zh: Bioavailability：釋放的物質有多少被患者吸收進入全身循環？
blocks.en: Bioavailability: how much of the released substance is absorbed by the patient into the systemic circulation?

blocks.zh: 這三個數字串聯起來，就是 Dose（劑量），然後才能與 Tolerable Intake (TI) 比較，得出風險估算結論。
blocks.en: Linked together, these three figures give the Dose, which is then compared with the Tolerable Intake (TI) to reach a risk estimation conclusion.

blocks.zh: CDMO 關鍵連結：容器密封系統資格確認
blocks.en: Key CDMO link: container closure system qualification

blocks.zh: 你的容器密封系統（Container-Closure System）資格確認研究 —— 包括 E&L 測試、相容性測試 —— 直接為 B.3.1.3 的風險估算步驟提供輸入資料。
blocks.en: Your Container-Closure System qualification studies, including E&L testing and compatibility testing, directly provide input data for the risk estimation step in B.3.1.3.

blocks.zh: 換言之：CCS 驗證不是獨立的品管活動，它是生物風險評估的數據來源之一。未來向客戶解釋為什麼要做 E&L 研究時，可以用這個框架說明其法規必要性。
blocks.en: In other words: CCS validation is not a standalone quality control activity; it is one of the data sources for the biological risk assessment. When you later explain to a client why E&L studies are needed, you can use this framework to show the regulatory necessity.

blocks.zh: 生物相容性的「情境依賴性」
blocks.en: The "context dependence" of biocompatibility

blocks.zh: B.3.1.4 說得很清楚：生物相容性只能在「特定情境下」對特定材料加以論證，這個情境包括用途和接觸組織。
blocks.en: B.3.1.4 is very clear: biocompatibility can only be demonstrated for a specific material "in a specific context", and this context includes the intended use and the tissue contacted.

blocks.zh: 類比：同一種矽膠，用在皮膚接觸的醫療貼片上，和用在長期植入的骨科器材上，需要的生物安全性數據完全不同。不能拿皮膚接觸的數據去支持長期植入的應用。
blocks.en: Analogy: the same silicone used in a skin-contact medical patch and in a long-term implanted orthopedic device requires completely different biological safety data. Skin-contact data cannot be used to support a long-term implant application.

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 來說，這意味著：客戶提供的材料安全數據是否「情境相符」，必須仔細審查。
blocks.en: For a CDMO, this means the material safety data provided by the client must be reviewed carefully to confirm it is "context-appropriate".

blocks.zh: 風險控制的優先順序（3R 精神）
blocks.en: Priority order of risk control (the spirit of the 3Rs)

blocks.zh: B.3.2 明確規定風險控制的優先順序：
blocks.en: B.3.2 sets out the priority order of risk control explicitly:

blocks.zh: 設計變更（Design change）—— 最優先
blocks.en: Design change (highest priority)

blocks.zh: 重新配方 / 材料替換（Reformulation / Material substitution）
blocks.en: Reformulation / material substitution

blocks.zh: in vitro 測試提供更準確的風險估算
blocks.en: In vitro testing to provide a more accurate risk estimate

blocks.zh: 警語 / 禁忌症標示（Warnings / Contraindications）
blocks.en: Warnings / contraindications labeling

blocks.zh: 動物測試 —— 最後手段，且只在其他方法都窮盡後才考慮
blocks.en: Animal testing: the last resort, considered only after all other methods are exhausted

blocks.zh: 這個順序體現了 3R 原則（Replace / Reduce / Refine）的精神。
blocks.en: This order reflects the spirit of the 3Rs principle (Replace / Reduce / Refine).

blocks.zh: 上市後監測：生物評估不是一次性活動
blocks.en: Post-market monitoring: biological evaluation is not a one-time activity

blocks.zh: B.3.4 強調：生物評估是持續性的。上市後必須持續監測：
blocks.en: B.3.4 stresses that biological evaluation is ongoing. After launch, the following must be monitored continuously:

blocks.zh: 本產品的不良事件趨勢
blocks.en: Adverse event trends for the product itself

blocks.zh: 同類材料或類似器材的相關新資訊
blocks.en: New relevant information on similar materials or similar devices

blocks.zh: 最新科學文獻的持續回顧
blocks.en: Ongoing review of the latest scientific literature

blocks.zh: 這個要求與 MDR/IVDR 的 Post-Market Clinical Follow-up (PMCF) 要求直接對應，也是 FDA 510(k) 上市後要求的一部分。
blocks.en: This requirement corresponds directly to the Post-Market Clinical Follow-up (PMCF) requirements of MDR/IVDR, and is also part of the FDA 510(k) post-market requirements.

blocks.zh: ISO 14971 vs. ISO 10993-1：風險管理映射
blocks.en: ISO 14971 vs. ISO 10993-1: risk management mapping

blocks.zh: Annex B 的架構完全對應 ISO 14971 的風險管理流程。以下是映射關係：
blocks.en: The structure of Annex B corresponds fully to the risk management process of ISO 14971. The mapping is as follows:

blocks.zh: 中文解析 — 材料表徵與測試策略
blocks.en: Commentary — Material Characterization and Testing Strategy

blocks.zh: 化學表徵的戰略價值
blocks.en: The strategic value of chemical characterization

blocks.zh: B.4.1.1 列出化學表徵最「物超所值」的使用情境。對 CDMO 而言，最常見的場景是：客戶改了一個原料成分，此時化學表徵可以幫助我們「聚焦」——只需評估那個被改變的成分的生物安全性，而不需要重做所有測試。
blocks.en: B.4.1.1 lists the situations in which chemical characterization gives the best value for effort. For a CDMO, the most common scenario is when a client changes one raw material component: chemical characterization helps us "focus", so that only the biological safety of the changed component needs to be evaluated, without repeating all testing.

blocks.zh: 這大幅降低了變更管理（Change Control）的成本和時間。
blocks.en: This greatly reduces the cost and time of change control.

blocks.zh: 專有配方的解法：Master File
blocks.en: The solution for proprietary formulations: the Master File

blocks.zh: B.4.1.3 提到一個很實用的機制：當供應商的配方是機密時，可以讓供應商把生物評估數據直接提交給主管機關（以 Master File 形式），由 CDMO 或藥廠在法規申請中引用，監管機關可以保密審查。
blocks.en: B.4.1.3 describes a very practical mechanism: when a supplier's formulation is confidential, the supplier can submit the biological evaluation data directly to the regulatory authority (as a Master File), which the CDMO or pharma company can then cite in its regulatory submission, and the authority can review it in confidence.

blocks.zh: 這個機制在 FDA 稱為 Drug Master File（DMF），在歐盟稱為 European Pharmacopoeia Master File（EDMF）。雖然 ISO 10993-1 講的是醫療器材語境，但概念是相通的。
blocks.en: This mechanism is called a Drug Master File (DMF) at the FDA and a European Drug Master File (EDMF) in the EU. Although ISO 10993-1 speaks in the context of medical devices, the concept is the same.

blocks.zh: 製造製程對生物相容性的影響：CDMO 必須重視
blocks.en: Impact of the manufacturing process on biocompatibility: CDMOs must take note

blocks.zh: B.4.1.5 是對 CDMO 最直接相關的條款之一。它說：測試樣品的處理方式必須與最終產品的材料處理方式「等效」，包括滅菌。
blocks.en: B.4.1.5 is one of the clauses most directly relevant to a CDMO. It says that test samples must be processed in a way that is "equivalent" to the processing of the materials in the final product, including sterilization.

blocks.zh: 實務含義：
blocks.en: Practical implications:

blocks.zh: 如果你用 EtO 滅菌，生物相容性測試的樣品也必須經過 EtO 滅菌後再測
blocks.en: If you use EtO sterilization, the biocompatibility test samples must also be EtO sterilized before testing

blocks.zh: 如果換了滅菌方式（如從 EtO 改為 gamma），需要重新評估
blocks.en: If the sterilization method changes (for example, from EtO to gamma), re-evaluation is required

blocks.zh: 清潔劑殘留、模具脫模劑殘留都是潛在污染物，必須納入考量
blocks.en: Detergent residues and mold release agent residues are potential contaminants and must be taken into account

blocks.zh: 奈米材料的特殊注意事項
blocks.en: Special considerations for nanomaterials

blocks.zh: B.4.1.4 指出奈米材料（nanomaterials）需要特別的物理表徵，因為次微米尺寸的材料可能表現出與大尺寸相同材料截然不同的生物行為。這意味著不能直接外推大尺寸材料的安全數據到奈米材料。
blocks.en: B.4.1.4 points out that nanomaterials require special physical characterization, because submicron-sized materials may show biological behavior quite different from the same material at larger sizes. This means safety data for larger-size material cannot be extrapolated directly to nanomaterials.

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO：如果你的製程涉及奈米粒子藥物製劑（如 LNP for mRNA vaccines），這個條款直接適用。
blocks.en: For a CDMO: if your process involves nanoparticle drug formulations (such as LNP for mRNA vaccines), this clause applies directly.

blocks.zh: 分層測試策略（Tiered Approach）
blocks.en: Tiered testing strategy (Tiered Approach)

blocks.zh: B.4.3.1 規定了測試的正確順序，必須遵守這個優先級：
blocks.en: B.4.3.1 sets the correct order of testing, and this priority must be followed:

blocks.zh: 物理與化學表徵（Physical & Chemical Characterization）
blocks.en: Physical & Chemical Characterization

blocks.zh: 體外測試 / in vitro 篩選
blocks.en: In vitro testing / in vitro screening

blocks.zh: 動物測試（必須先完成前兩步並評估結果，才能進行）
blocks.en: Animal testing (permitted only after the first two steps are completed and their results evaluated)

blocks.zh: 直接跳到動物測試是不符合 ISO 10993-1 要求的，也違反 3R 原則。監管機關越來越嚴格審查這個順序的遵從性。
blocks.en: Going straight to animal testing does not meet the requirements of ISO 10993-1 and also violates the 3Rs principle. Regulatory authorities are scrutinizing compliance with this order more and more strictly.

blocks.zh: 長期測試的決策邏輯
blocks.en: Decision logic for long-term testing

blocks.zh: B.4.3.2 給出了「不需要」做長期測試的理由框架：如果你能證明暴露量極低（低於毒理學閾值），暴露時間短，且生物利用度低，就可以有理由豁免長期測試。
blocks.en: B.4.3.2 gives a framework of reasons for when long-term testing is "not needed": if you can show that exposure is extremely low (below the toxicological threshold), exposure duration is short, and bioavailability is low, there can be justification for waiving long-term testing.

blocks.zh: 這個邏輯就是所謂的 Risk-based Justification —— 用數據論證為什麼不需要測試，而不是隨意跳過測試。
blocks.en: This logic is what is called a Risk-based Justification: using data to argue why testing is not needed, rather than skipping tests arbitrarily.

blocks.zh: 反之，如果材料有已知的毒性結構特徵（如特定的 genotoxic 官能基），或 genotoxicity 篩選顯示有問題，就必須做長期測試。
blocks.en: Conversely, if the material has known toxic structural features (such as specific genotoxic functional groups), or genotoxicity screening shows a problem, long-term testing must be performed.

blocks.zh: 中文解析 — 安全評估方法與變更管理
blocks.en: Commentary — Safety Evaluation Methods and Change Management

blocks.zh: 「足夠的臨床數據」怎麼判斷？
blocks.en: How do you judge "sufficient clinical data"?

blocks.zh: B.4.4.1 提供了一個強有力的工具：如果一種材料在相同的應用中有長期安全使用歷史（且配方和製程完全相同），這就可以作為風險評估的充分依據，不需要重新做大量測試。
blocks.en: B.4.4.1 provides a powerful tool: if a material has a long history of safe use in the same application (with identical formulation and process), this can serve as sufficient basis for the risk assessment, without repeating extensive testing.

blocks.zh: 這就是 History of Safe Use 論證策略。對 CDMO 特別有價值的場景：客戶使用了業界已有幾十年使用歷史的標準輔料（如 polysorbate 80），可以援引文獻和臨床記錄來支持生物安全性，而無需做全套新測試。
blocks.en: This is the History of Safe Use justification strategy. A scenario of particular value to a CDMO: the client uses a standard excipient with decades of industry use (such as polysorbate 80), and can cite literature and clinical records to support biological safety without running a full set of new tests.

blocks.zh: Dose/TI 比值：不是硬性截止線
blocks.en: Dose/TI ratio: not a hard cut-off

blocks.zh: B.4.4.3 澄清了一個常見誤解：Dose/TI > 1 並不自動意味著「不合格」——它只是表示「風險升高的可能性」。評估人員必須同時考量：
blocks.en: B.4.4.3 clarifies a common misunderstanding: Dose/TI > 1 does not automatically mean "fail"; it only indicates an "increased likelihood of risk". The evaluator must also consider:

blocks.zh: 毒性反應的嚴重程度
blocks.en: The severity of the toxic reaction

blocks.zh: 化合物的藥動學特性
blocks.en: The pharmacokinetic properties of the compound

blocks.zh: 萃取條件是否保守（worst case）
blocks.en: Whether the extraction conditions are conservative (worst case)

blocks.zh: TI 計算中使用的假設是否過於保守
blocks.en: Whether the assumptions used in the TI calculation are overly conservative

blocks.zh: 這個彈性空間是有意設計的 —— 監管邏輯不是「有就不行」，而是「超出閾值需要更詳細的論證」。
blocks.en: This flexibility is deliberate: the regulatory logic is not "if it is present, it is unacceptable", but "exceeding the threshold requires a more detailed justification".

blocks.zh: 混合物毒性：現實比模型複雜
blocks.en: Mixture toxicity: reality is more complex than the model

blocks.zh: B.4.4.5 承認了生物評估中最棘手的問題之一：患者同時暴露於多種 leachables，而不是單一化合物。
blocks.en: B.4.4.5 acknowledges one of the thorniest problems in biological evaluation: patients are exposed to multiple leachables at the same time, not to a single compound.

blocks.zh: 現實情況：目前業界主要採用 additive toxicity（加成毒性） 假設來處理混合物，即假設各化合物的效應可以直接加總。這是保守但務實的方法。ISO 10993-17 Annex B 有更詳細的混合物評估方法指引。
blocks.en: In practice: the industry currently handles mixtures mainly by assuming additive toxicity, that is, assuming the effects of the individual compounds can simply be summed. This is a conservative but pragmatic approach. ISO 10993-17 Annex B gives more detailed guidance on methods for evaluating mixtures.

blocks.zh: 什麼樣的「變更」需要重做生物評估？
blocks.en: What kinds of "changes" require biological evaluation to be repeated?

blocks.zh: B.4.5.1 的變更清單對 CDMO 的 Change Control 程序直接相關：
blocks.en: The list of changes in B.4.5.1 is directly relevant to a CDMO's Change Control procedure:

blocks.zh: 換供應商 → 需要重評
blocks.en: Change of supplier → re-evaluation required

blocks.zh: 換滅菌方式 → 需要重評
blocks.en: Change of sterilization method → re-evaluation required

blocks.zh: 改包裝材料 → 需要重評
blocks.en: Change of packaging material → re-evaluation required

blocks.zh: 延長保質期 → 可能需要重評（更長的老化時間可能改變 leachables 量）
blocks.en: Extended shelf life → re-evaluation may be required (longer aging time may change the amount of leachables)

blocks.zh: 臨床使用方式改變 → 需要重評
blocks.en: Change in clinical use → re-evaluation required

blocks.zh: 重評的範圍不需要是全套 —— 只需聚焦在「被改變的部分」以及「可能受影響的生物安全性端點」。
blocks.en: The scope of re-evaluation does not need to be the full set; it only needs to focus on "the part that changed" and "the biological safety endpoints that may be affected".

blocks.zh: GLP 要求：什麼情況下必須用 GLP 實驗室？
blocks.en: GLP requirements: when must a GLP laboratory be used?

blocks.zh: B.4.5.2 要求生物評估測試必須符合 GLP，實驗室應通過 ISO/IEC 17025 認證。
blocks.en: B.4.5.2 requires that biological evaluation testing comply with GLP, and that the laboratory be accredited to ISO/IEC 17025.

blocks.zh: 委外測試時，必須確認 CRO 有適當的 GLP/GCP 認證
blocks.en: When testing is outsourced, confirm that the CRO holds appropriate GLP/GCP certification

blocks.zh: 測試報告必須包含驗證和可追溯性記錄
blocks.en: Test reports must include validation and traceability records

blocks.zh: 數據的完整性（Data Integrity）要求同樣適用於生物評估
blocks.en: Data integrity requirements apply equally to biological evaluation

blocks.zh: 生物相容性評估文件：完整的文件包
blocks.en: Biocompatibility evaluation documentation: the complete document package

blocks.zh: B.4.5.3 列出的文件清單，就是監管機關在審查技術文件（Technical File）或 510(k) 時會查的內容。缺少任何一項都可能導致資訊補充要求（Deficiency Letter）。
blocks.en: The list of documents in B.4.5.3 is what regulatory authorities will check when reviewing the Technical File or a 510(k). Missing any single item may lead to a request for further information (Deficiency Letter).

blocks.zh: 最容易被忽略的項目：「確認風險分析和風險控制已完成的聲明」—— 這是一份正式的結案聲明，必須由具備資質的評估人員簽署。
blocks.en: The item most easily overlooked: the "statement confirming that risk analysis and risk control are complete". This is a formal closing statement and must be signed by a qualified evaluator.

blocks.zh: 中文解析 — 系統性文獻審查程序
blocks.en: Commentary — Systematic Literature Review Procedure

blocks.zh: 文獻審查的雙重功能
blocks.en: The dual function of the literature review

blocks.zh: Annex C 強調文獻審查有兩個核心目的：
blocks.en: Annex C stresses that a literature review has two core purposes:

blocks.zh: 替代測試：如果現有文獻已足以支持生物安全性論證，就不需要再做新的動物或體外測試
blocks.en: Replacing testing: if the existing literature is already sufficient to support the biological safety argument, no new animal or in vitro testing is needed

blocks.zh: 識別數據缺口：如果文獻不足，則指出哪些缺口需要通過新測試來填補
blocks.en: Identifying data gaps: if the literature is insufficient, it points out which gaps need to be filled by new testing

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 的實務價值：一份好的文獻審查報告可以省下大量時間和成本，因為它可能讓你有理由跳過某些測試，同時向監管機關展示你做了嚴謹的科學評估。
blocks.en: Practical value for a CDMO: a good literature review report can save a great deal of time and cost, because it may give you grounds to skip certain tests while also showing regulatory authorities that you carried out a rigorous scientific evaluation.

blocks.zh: 文獻審查是「科學活動」，不是「搜尋練習」
blocks.en: A literature review is a "scientific activity", not a "search exercise"

blocks.zh: C.1 特別強調：文獻審查必須以「嚴謹性和客觀性」進行，且必須能夠被第三方驗證。
blocks.en: C.1 stresses that the literature review must be carried out with "rigor and objectivity" and must be verifiable by a third party.

blocks.zh: 類比：就像一篇 systematic review 論文，需要有預先定義的搜尋策略、納入/排除標準、數據萃取方法，最終結論必須由數據支持，而不是研究者的主觀印象。
blocks.en: Analogy: like a systematic review paper, it needs a predefined search strategy, inclusion/exclusion criteria and data extraction methods, and the final conclusion must be supported by the data, not by the researcher's subjective impression.

blocks.zh: 常見錯誤：把 Google Scholar 的隨機搜尋結果彙整成「文獻審查」。監管機關現在對這份文件的要求越來越接近 clinical evidence systematic review 的標準。
blocks.en: Common mistake: compiling random Google Scholar search results into a "literature review". Regulatory authorities now expect this document to come closer and closer to the standard of a clinical evidence systematic review.

blocks.zh: 文獻審查計劃：事前定義，事後記錄
blocks.en: Literature review plan: define beforehand, document afterwards

blocks.zh: C.2.1 要求在執行前就建立計劃，必須文件化：
blocks.en: C.2.1 requires that a plan be established before execution, and that it document:

blocks.zh: 搜尋資料庫（PubMed、EMBASE、Cochrane、監管數據庫）
blocks.en: Search databases (PubMed, EMBASE, Cochrane, regulatory databases)

blocks.zh: 搜尋關鍵字和策略（MeSH terms + free text）
blocks.en: Search keywords and strategy (MeSH terms + free text)

blocks.zh: 時間範圍（通常近 10 年為主）
blocks.en: Time range (usually the most recent 10 years)

blocks.zh: 語言限制（英文為主，重要的可包含其他語言）
blocks.en: Language restrictions (mainly English; important papers in other languages may be included)

blocks.zh: 納入標準（Study type? Sample size? Relevance?）
blocks.en: Inclusion criteria (Study type? Sample size? Relevance?)

blocks.zh: 排除標準（與排除理由）
blocks.en: Exclusion criteria (with reasons for exclusion)

blocks.zh: 關鍵資料庫清單（來自 Bibliography）
blocks.en: Key database list (from the Bibliography)

blocks.zh: ISO 10993-1 的 Bibliography 直接引用了以下數據庫，說明這些是業界認可的文獻來源：
blocks.en: The Bibliography of ISO 10993-1 directly cites the following databases, indicating that these are industry-recognized literature sources:

blocks.zh: PubMed — US National Library of Medicine（最廣泛使用）
blocks.en: PubMed: US National Library of Medicine (most widely used)

blocks.zh: EMBASE — Elsevier（歐洲藥學/毒理學文獻強項）
blocks.en: EMBASE: Elsevier (strong in European pharmaceutical/toxicology literature)

blocks.zh: BIOSIS Previews — 生命科學文獻
blocks.en: BIOSIS Previews: life sciences literature

blocks.zh: SciFinder — 化學結構搜尋（美國化學學會）
blocks.en: SciFinder: chemical structure search (American Chemical Society)

blocks.zh: IPCS (WHO) — 國際化學品安全規範
blocks.en: IPCS (WHO): International Programme on Chemical Safety

blocks.zh: IRIS (EPA) — 美國環保署毒理學數據庫
blocks.en: IRIS (EPA): US EPA toxicology database

blocks.zh: ATSDR ToxGuides — 有毒物質與疾病登錄署
blocks.en: ATSDR ToxGuides: Agency for Toxic Substances and Disease Registry

blocks.zh: 數據品質加權：GLP > Non-GLP
blocks.en: Data quality weighting: GLP > Non-GLP

blocks.zh: C.2.3 指出可以優先採用 GLP 數據，但不排除 non-GLP 數據 —— 後者必須說明你如何評估其可靠性。
blocks.en: C.2.3 notes that GLP data may be given priority, but non-GLP data is not excluded; for the latter you must explain how you evaluated its reliability.

blocks.zh: C.2.5 提出的加權方法特別提醒：同一作者的重複發表可能造成過度加權（over-weighting）。這在某些材料的文獻中很常見 —— 某個研究組可能發表了多篇基於同一數據集的論文。
blocks.en: The weighting method proposed in C.2.5 specifically warns that repeated publications by the same author may cause over-weighting. This is common in the literature on some materials: a research group may publish several papers based on the same dataset.

blocks.zh: 文獻審查報告必備要素（C.2.5）
blocks.en: Essential elements of a literature review report (C.2.5)

blocks.zh: 器材/材料簡要描述（含預期用途）
blocks.en: Brief description of the device/material (including intended use)

blocks.zh: 所有選入文獻的分析（包括不利數據，不能只選對自己有利的）
blocks.en: Analysis of all selected literature (including unfavorable data; you cannot select only what favors you)

blocks.zh: 危害、風險與安全措施的批判性評估
blocks.en: Critical evaluation of hazards, risks and safety measures

blocks.zh: 不同論文的加權方法說明
blocks.en: Explanation of the weighting method applied to different papers

blocks.zh: 文獻引用清單（可交叉引用）
blocks.en: List of literature citations (cross-referenceable)

blocks.zh: 結論與論證（說明目標如何達成、哪些缺口已識別）
blocks.en: Conclusions and justification (explaining how the objectives were achieved and which gaps were identified)

blocks.zh: 審查者簽名 + 日期（不可缺少！）
blocks.en: Reviewer signature + date (must not be omitted!)

blocks.zh: 第 2 點「包括不利數據」至關重要：監管機關會看你有沒有刻意忽略不支持你結論的文獻。
blocks.en: Item 2, "including unfavorable data", is critical: regulatory authorities will look at whether you deliberately ignored literature that does not support your conclusion.

blocks.zh: ISO Standards ISO 標準
blocks.en: ISO Standards

blocks.zh: Regulatory Guidance 法規指引
blocks.en: Regulatory Guidance

blocks.zh: ICH Guidelines ICH 指引
blocks.en: ICH Guidelines

blocks.zh: Literature Databases 文獻資料庫
blocks.en: Literature Databases

blocks.zh: Key Textbooks 重要教科書
blocks.en: Key Textbooks

blocks.zh: 中文解析 — 參考書目的戰略意涵
blocks.en: Commentary — Strategic Implications of the Bibliography

blocks.zh: CDMO 的雙軌專業需求
blocks.en: The CDMO's dual-track expertise requirement

blocks.zh: ICH Q3 系列傳統上屬於藥品（pharmaceutical）領域，而 ISO 10993 屬於醫療器材（medical device）領域。但在 CDMO 的實際工作中，這兩個世界的交叉越來越普遍：
blocks.en: The ICH Q3 series traditionally belongs to the pharmaceutical domain, while ISO 10993 belongs to the medical device domain. But in a CDMO's actual work, the overlap between these two worlds is increasingly common:

blocks.zh: 藥品包裝材料（如注射劑的橡膠塞、玻璃瓶）既是「藥品輔料」也是「接觸患者的器材」
blocks.en: Pharmaceutical packaging materials (such as rubber stoppers and glass vials for injectables) are both "pharmaceutical components" and "devices that contact the patient"

blocks.zh: 組合產品（Combination Products）同時受藥品法規和器材法規管轄
blocks.en: Combination Products are governed by both drug and device regulations

blocks.zh: E&L 研究同時服務於 ICH Q3 的雜質控制和 ISO 10993 的生物安全評估
blocks.en: E&L studies serve both the impurity control of ICH Q3 and the biological safety evaluation of ISO 10993

blocks.zh: 這就是為什麼 CDMO 的法規事務團隊必須同時熟悉兩套體系，而不能只懂其中一個。
blocks.en: This is why a CDMO's regulatory affairs team must be familiar with both systems, not just one.

blocks.zh: FDA Guidance [30] 的重要性
blocks.en: The importance of FDA Guidance [30]

blocks.zh: Bibliography [30] 引用了 FDA 2016 年發布的 ISO 10993-1 使用指引（"Use of International Standard ISO 10993-1 — Guidance for Industry and FDA Staff"）。這份文件非常重要，因為它告訴你 FDA 如何解讀和應用 ISO 10993-1 —— 而 FDA 的解讀有時與 ISO 標準本身有微妙差異。
blocks.en: Bibliography [30] cites the FDA guidance on the use of ISO 10993-1 issued in 2016 ("Use of International Standard ISO 10993-1 — Guidance for Industry and FDA Staff"). This document is very important because it tells you how the FDA interprets and applies ISO 10993-1, and the FDA's interpretation sometimes differs subtly from the ISO standard itself.

blocks.zh: 例如：FDA 在某些測試要求上比 ISO 10993-1 更嚴格，需要額外的毒理學論證。在向 FDA 提交 510(k) 或 PMA 前，必須同時參照這份 FDA 指引。
blocks.en: For example, the FDA is stricter than ISO 10993-1 on some testing requirements and requires additional toxicological justification. Before submitting a 510(k) or PMA to the FDA, you must refer to this FDA guidance as well.

blocks.zh: OECD 毒理學測試指南 [26]
blocks.en: OECD toxicology testing guidelines [26]

blocks.zh: OECD Guidelines for the Testing of Chemicals Section 4（健康效應）是業界進行毒理學測試時最廣泛引用的方法學標準。當 ISO 10993-x 系列指定某個測試「應按照 OECD 指南進行」，指的就是這套文件。
blocks.en: The OECD Guidelines for the Testing of Chemicals, Section 4 (Health Effects), are the most widely cited methodological standards for toxicology testing in the industry. When the ISO 10993-x series specifies that a test "shall be performed in accordance with OECD guidelines", this is the set of documents it refers to.

blocks.zh: 對 CRO 選擇：委外測試時，確認 CRO 的測試方法符合 OECD 相關指南，是品質保證的基本要求。
blocks.en: On CRO selection: when testing is outsourced, confirming that the CRO's test methods comply with the relevant OECD guidelines is a basic quality assurance requirement.

blocks.zh: 知識體系建議：CDMO 法規團隊必讀清單
blocks.en: Knowledge base recommendation: required reading list for CDMO regulatory teams

blocks.zh: ISO 10993-1:2018 本文 + Annex B + Annex C（本文件）
blocks.en: ISO 10993-1:2018 main body + Annex B + Annex C (this document)

blocks.zh: ISO 10993-17（毒理學風險評估方法）
blocks.en: ISO 10993-17 (toxicological risk assessment methods)

blocks.zh: ISO 10993-18（化學表徵）
blocks.en: ISO 10993-18 (chemical characterization)

blocks.zh: ISO 14971:2019（醫療器材風險管理）
blocks.en: ISO 14971:2019 (risk management for medical devices)

blocks.zh: ICH Q3D（元素雜質 — 注射劑最相關）
blocks.en: ICH Q3D (elemental impurities; most relevant for injectables)

blocks.zh: ICH Q3C（殘留溶媒）
blocks.en: ICH Q3C (residual solvents)

blocks.zh: FDA 2016 ISO 10993-1 使用指引
blocks.en: FDA 2016 guidance on the use of ISO 10993-1

blocks.zh: PQRI Leachables & Extractables Working Group guidance（藥品包裝 E&L 最重要的業界指引）
blocks.en: PQRI Leachables & Extractables Working Group guidance (the most important industry guidance for E&L of pharmaceutical packaging)

blocks.zh: 總結：Annex B + C 的核心價值
blocks.en: Summary: the core value of Annex B + C

blocks.zh: 如果整本 ISO 10993-1 只能讀兩個附錄，就讀 Annex B 和 Annex C。
blocks.en: If you could read only two annexes of the whole of ISO 10993-1, read Annex B and Annex C.

blocks.zh: Annex B 告訴你怎麼把風險管理框架落地成可操作的評估流程；Annex C 告訴你怎麼把文獻審查做到符合監管要求的科學水準。這兩份附錄加在一起，就是一份完整的「生物評估作業手冊」。
blocks.en: Annex B tells you how to turn the risk management framework into an operational evaluation process; Annex C tells you how to carry out a literature review to a scientific standard that meets regulatory expectations. Together, these two annexes make a complete "biological evaluation operations manual".

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 的最終啟示：生物評估不是一個「一次性的測試清單」，而是一個貫穿產品生命週期的持續性風險管理活動。從 tech transfer 的第一天，到上市後的持續監測，每一個環節都在 Annex B 的框架之內。
blocks.en: The final takeaway for a CDMO: biological evaluation is not a "one-time test list" but an ongoing risk management activity that runs through the product lifecycle. From the first day of tech transfer to post-market monitoring, every step falls within the framework of Annex B.

blocks.zh: ICH Q3 系列 × ISO 10993：雙軌知識體系
blocks.en: ICH Q3 series × ISO 10993: a dual-track knowledge base

blocks.zh: Bibliography 中引用了 ICH Q3A/Q3B/Q3C/Q3D/M7 這五個核心指引，這個事實說明了一個重要的知識融合趨勢：醫療器材的生物安全評估與藥品雜質/殘留物評估正在越來越多地使用共同的毒理學工具和閾值標準。
blocks.en: The Bibliography cites the five core guidelines ICH Q3A/Q3B/Q3C/Q3D/M7, which points to an important trend of knowledge convergence: the biological safety evaluation of medical devices and the evaluation of impurities/residues in pharmaceuticals are increasingly using common toxicological tools and threshold standards.
